prompt: Which pair of hall cards follows the makers’ choices?
promptZh: 哪一組展場展卡符合兩位製作者的選擇？

options.text: Include Tessa King on the card for Harbor Steps (17); omit Lin Bell from the card for Orchard Road (42).
options.zh: 17 號《港口階梯》加印泰莎・金；42 號《果園路》不印琳・貝爾。
options.whyZh: 兩位製作者的選擇被對調了：泰莎不同意展場署名，琳同意。

options.text: Omit Tessa King from the card for Harbor Steps (17); include Lin Bell on the card for Orchard Road (42).
options.zh: 17 號《港口階梯》不印泰莎・金；42 號《果園路》加印琳・貝爾。
options.whyZh: 泰莎不同意在展卡署名，所以只印編號和作品名稱；琳已同意署名，可印她的姓名。

options.text: Print 17 and 42 with both makers’ names on their respective cards.
options.zh: 17 號和 42 號的展卡各印製作者姓名。
options.whyZh: 琳同意，泰莎不同意；同意上傳照片不是同意展卡署名。

options.text: Print 17 and 42 without titles or names.
options.zh: 17 號和 42 號都只印編號，不印作品名或姓名。
options.whyZh: 展場未獲署名授權的展卡仍要印作品名稱；琳的展卡也可依其授權署名。

explanationZh: 泰莎不同意在展卡署名，所以只印編號和作品名稱；琳已同意署名，可印她的姓名。
evidence: To credit the maker by name on that card, check the maker’s show form. If they did not give permission for a name credit in the hall, print the entry number and quilt title only. / Tessa declined name credit on the hall card but approved photos for the online gallery. / Lin approved name credit on the hall card but did not approve any online photos, even pictures that leave out her name.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: To credit the maker by name on that card, check the maker’s show form. If they did not give permission for a name credit in the hall, print the entry number and quilt title only.
Tessa declined name credit on the hall card but approved photos for the online gallery.
Lin approved name credit on the hall card but did not approve any online photos, even pictures that leave out her name.

vocabulary.note: 在展卡上印製作者姓名以標明作品出處。
